comment: Hand-annotated phase boundaries (methodology §7, M12). Position k = after ply k. lastBookPosition is an input here (null = no Book position, so the 12-move guard is position 24). Each boundary names the move that causes it.

games.notes: Guard = 12 + 24 = 36. Ply 35 (18.Rxe2) leaves 10 pieces and White 3 pieces on rank 1. Ply 48 (24...Kxf8) leaves 6 pieces.
No Book position: the guard (position 24) comes before any material or back-rank trigger (ply 35).
Ply 17 (9.Qxd3) leaves White 3 pieces on rank 1 (sparse). Ply 41 (21.Nxe4) leaves 6 pieces. Ply 85 (each side down to one rook) is already in the endgame.
Ply 22 (11...Qd7) leaves Black 3 pieces on rank 8 (sparse), before the guard at 24. Ply 66 (33...Rxf3) leaves 6 pieces.
A 20-ply game: never fewer than 12 pieces, never fewer than 4 pieces on either first rank, and the guard (24) is never reached. The whole game is the opening; no middlegame and no endgame.
